questions.question: Including one-time use sorbent booms, what total length of booms was deployed during the Deepwater Horizon response?
How many sorties were flown to release the dispersant product during the spill response?
How large was the no-fly zone that aviation regulators imposed over the spill response operations area?
How many claimants did the independent auditor of the Gulf Coast Claims Facility find had been wrongly denied or underpaid?
During the negative pressure test on the Macondo well, what drill pipe pressure result was ignored?
Despite the recommendation to circulate one bottoms up before the cement job, how many barrels of mud did BP actually cycle?
Under the Limitation of Shipowner's Liability Act, at what value did Transocean put its interest in the Deepwater Horizon?
How many species did the comprehensive 2009 census of offshore Gulf species tally?
In its testimony to the U.S. House Judiciary Committee, how many lawsuits did Transocean say it was a defendant in?
Through which captive insurance vehicle does BP largely underwrite its own risk?
Of the Corexit shipped to the stricken tanker Esso Essen in April 1968, how much was actually sprayed onto the slick by aircraft?
The firm that fabricated the rig's well-control stack -- which a congressional inquiry found had a fluid leak and a dead battery -- agreed in December 2011 to pay BP how much?
The chemicals company whose shares jumped 18% in one day in May 2010 once it emerged its dispersant was being used became, in 2011, the property of which company?
The partner that held a 10% stake in the Macondo Prospect through a Mitsui unit agreed to pay how much to the Oil Spill Liability Trust Fund?
The BP manager who was angry that the MC 252 well was over budget and refused his technical staff's recommendation to re-squeeze it was later charged with what federal offence?
The Corexit formulation the EPA measured as 63.4% effective in dispersing Louisiana crude was used, with Corexit 7764, during which 1992 oil spill in South Australia?
The US District Judge who in December 2012 dismissed all claims against the manufacturer of Corexit presided over which multidistrict litigation docket?
Of the eleven workers named as killed in the Deepwater Horizon explosion, how many are listed with a home town in Louisiana?
Under the January 2013 Justice Department announcement, what was the aggregate sum the Mitsui affiliate was directed to disburse?

This dossier gives two different volumes for the Corexit applied at the Macondo wellhead -- one in the account of dispersant use during the response, the other from a January 2011 Woods Hole Oceanographic Institute study. What is the difference between them, in US gallons?
